Hi Naomi,

We're ready to proceed with our upcoming renewal (term ends 2027-06-30) and want to add an extra 250k token capacity for Q3. Procurement has prepared a PO and asked whether Redwood can accept Net45 for this renewal (we typically do Net30, but our treasury has requested a slight extension).

Attached: Stellarnet_PO_2027.pdf (PO for renewal + capacity add-on)

Could you please:
- Confirm Redwood can accept Net45 for this renewal (deal D-4729-AX)
- Issue a proforma invoice showing the one-time proration for the added capacity and the new annual commitment amount
- Confirm the billing contact to whom the invoice should be sent (we would prefer Tom Hayes, tom.hayes@stellarnet.com)
- Confirm whether you need a W-9 or VAT form from us (we are US-based; I can attach a signed W-9 if needed)

If you need anything else from procurement to complete the PO, let me know and I'll loop them in. We're hoping to close this week so services don't gap.

Thanks —
Elena Ruiz

Thanks Naomi — reviewed the PO. A few finance items before we can accept Net45 and book the proforma:  

1) Billing entity verification: PO references "Stellarnet, Inc." — please confirm this is the legal payor and matches the W-9 tax name and EIN. If the payor is a different affiliated entity, we need a payor letter or amended PO.
2) W-9: yes, we need a signed W-9 (or valid tax certificate) to process the PO for a US entity. Elena — please attach when available.
3) Payment method: confirm if they will pay via ACH/EFT or wire. For Net45 exceptions we require ACH authorization or pre-approved wire routing to expedite.
4) Invoice cadence & proration: we'll issue one proforma invoice for the proration + the renewed annual commitment (single invoice preferred). Confirm the service start date for the add-on so we correctly prorate.
5) Approval for Net45: Finance is ok to approve a one-time Net45 for D-4729-AX provided we receive the signed W-9 and the PO aligns with the invoiced legal entity.

Next steps I propose:
- Naomi: confirm billing contact and service start date for add-on with Elena.
- Elena: send signed W-9 and confirm payment method (ACH preferred).
- Kimberly: if Net45 is acceptable commercially, please confirm so I can proceed to generate the proforma and accept the PO in our system.

I'll prepare a draft proforma once we have the W-9 and legal-entity confirmation.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

Here's what I'll send by end of day:
- Draft addendum to the Master Services Agreement reflecting the term extension and Net45 (Connor, please review the attached draft when I drop it). [Attachment: Draft_Addendum_2027.docx]
- Proforma invoice that includes the proration for the 250k token add-on and the updated annual commitment total.

Elena — can you confirm the service start date you want for the extra capacity (they typically prefer 2027-07-01) and confirm Tom Hayes as the billing contact (tom.hayes@stellarnet.com)? If Tom needs separate invoicing recipients or a billing PO number, include it in your reply.

Once Finance receives the signed W-9 and confirms ACH/wire details, Marcus will accept the PO and we can finalize the addendum. We'll aim to have the docs routed for signature within 48 hours after those items are in.
